record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare FELL_STINGER: Poipole (2 stars, base atk 10, passive POIPOLE) and Naganadel (3 stars, base atk 20, passive NAGANADEL); both have maxPP 75 and range 1. The strategy is shared; the unit differences are the star count and the base attack. The unit passives were not traced here.

dispatch.note: Direct registry entry with a dedicated file; no routing uncertainty was queued.

record.summary: Single-target SPECIAL damage on the cast target: requested damage = multiplier x the caster's baseAtk, with multiplier 4 for stars 1-3 and 8 for star 4 (Poipole 4 x 10 = 40, Naganadel 4 x 20 = 80 requested before AP and defences). If the hit kills the target and the caster is not a spawn, the caster gains 0.3 x baseAtk Attack (3 for Poipole, 6 for Naganadel before the Big Eater Belt and rounding), without AP scaling. No status or movement.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

effects.scaling: Requested = multiplier x baseAtk, where baseAtk is the board Pokemon's atk copied when the fight entity was created (not the current atk after buffs in the fight). With the catalog atk: Poipole 40, Naganadel 80 (baseAtk may differ from the catalog atk if a permanent buff exists on the board Pokemon at creation; Naganadel's onAcquired subtracts 10 atk). AP: x(1 + AP/100); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false).
effects.resolution: Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) [x crit], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, minimum 1) in handleDamage; shields and takenDamage are resolved in handleDamage and are not read by this strategy (only the death flag). Blocked completely (no damage, no kill) if the target is protected, skydiving or has magicBounce.

effects.scaling: addAttack(0.3 x baseAtk, self, apBoost 0, crit false): value = Math.round(0.3 x baseAtk) (AP does not scale it: apBoost 0); Big Eater Belt on the caster multiplies this positive value by 1.25 floored; Twist Band does not flip it (positive). No permanent flag, so the gain lasts for the fight only.
effects.resolution: Applied: atk = max(1, atk + value). `death` is true only when the hit left the target at hp <= 0 with no resurrection status to consume (a resurrecting or already dead target returns death false; Shiny Charm can also cancel the damage); a protected/skydiving/magicBounce target returns death false, so there is no gain. The gain does not feed back into this cast's damage because baseAtk is unchanged.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 8 (star 4) and 9 (fallback) entries are not reachable by these two units' star counts. Because both units' multiplier is 4, the difference in raw damage comes from their baseAtk. maxPP 75 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: None beyond needing a target (requiresTarget true).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. The attack gained on a kill stacks across kills for the rest of the fight but never changes baseAtk, so later casts keep the same requested damage.
record.rawVsResolved: Raw: multiplier 4 x baseAtk; kill bonus 0.3 x baseAtk. Requested damage = raw; applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) [x crit], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) in handleDamage. Requested attack gain = 0.3 x baseAtk rounded; applied gain after Big Eater Belt (x1.25 floored) and the atk floor of 1; no AP scaling; no Twist Band flip.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPECIAL speDef division, minimum of 1, the protect / skydiving / magicBounce block and the death flag logic were read here
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Whether the unit passives POIPOLE / NAGANADEL change baseAtk or atk during the fight (not read)
Where isSpawn is set true (not searched)
